segments.t: End at Rog'mar in Riverglades, at flight master Grakna (about 59.6, 45.1). You should be around level 40-41 on both routes. Stranglethorn, Arathi and Hillsbrad chains above level 40, and the Dustwallow and Swamp of Sorrows chains, continue on the 40-60 route. All Riverglades quests below 40 are done, including 94483, 96063 and 96104 (the 40-60 route's first accepts need those). This route sides with the Gelkis: Gelkis Alliance (1368), Stealing Supplies (1370), and Ongeku (1373) are on the route. Do not accept Valley of Bones (93034) when you turn in Ongeku; that starts the 40-60 Shen'dralas chapter. The next route begins by flying to Rog'mar. Druid Primal Bite is a level 40 ability, not 25.

actions.label: Handoff: you are at Grakna in Rog'mar, ready for the 40-60 route

tips.text: WoW Forever's Riverglades is 36-44; finish the last Rog'mar rounds and leave once quests turn green.

WoW Forever profession changes to keep in mind from 40 on: healing potions are now made with First Aid, any node or skin can give rare bonus materials, each corpse can be skinned only once, every profession unlocks a Camp feature at skill 20, and Merchant's Favor (from supply crates handed in at the Horde camp outside the Crossroads) buys around 320 recipes. Crafting items just to sell to vendors no longer pays, so craft for skill or for players.
Unverified: secondary guides put Apprentice riding at level 40 for 100 gold, including the first racial mount.
